**Daily Devotional**

**March 31**

*2 In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began; (Titus 1:2 KJV)*

The Greek word used for hope “ELPIS”, means expectation or anticipation, and doesn’t mean that Paul was unsure of his salvation. All of us that have been born again and believe in our Savior Jesus Christ are assured of our salvation, unless we renounce it ourselves and become reprobate, or blasphemy the Holy Ghost (Matthew 12:31-32), or refuse to obey Jesus (Hebrews 5:9). This verse says that God cannot lie, and also Hebrews (Hebrews 6:18) tells us the same thing. This is our assurance that all the promises in the Bible will be carried out, and we can be confident that our eternity will be with the Lord as promised.

If this promise was made before the world began, then God must have promised it to Himself, and that makes it a sure thing. Once God has promised anything, through out the history of the world, it has always come to pass just as He promised, and it always will. What a comfort to know that we have so many great promises in His Word, the Bible, and that all of them are true, without exception. We may change and the world may pass away, but the Word of God will never change (Matthew 24:35). Thank you Lord.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
